question.text: SEBI may ask a PM to disclose ALL of the following EXCEPT:

answer.text: Names of clients whose portfolio it has managed
Personal tax returns of the Compliance Officer's family

explanation.text: **The Logic:** SEBI may seek portfolio details, changes in particulars, client lists, net-worth — not CO family tax returns. **The Trap:** Personal family data is beyond SEBI's purview here. **Cross-Exam Context:** Same regulatory ask structure in III-A. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Keep SEBI responses time-bound (usually 15-30 days) and archive copies.
